title: Sliding window: variable size
learn: expand right, shrink left while invalid, track best; window state in a hash map
hook: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters is one of the most asked questions anywhere. Variable-size windows (expand right, shrink left) solve it and a whole family of "longest/shortest subarray such that…" problems in O(n).

explain.prompt: Explain the variable-size sliding window using Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters, and why it's O(n) even with a loop inside a loop.
keyPoints: expand the right edge one step at a time and add the new element to the window state
while the window breaks the rule, remove from the left and shrink
record longest after fixing the window (shortest: while valid, before shrinking)
each pointer only moves forward, at most n times each → O(n) total
needs a monotonic condition; negative numbers in sum problems break it
